arxiv-2101-04921.title: Neural Sequence-to-grid Module for Learning Symbolic Rules
arxiv-2101-04921.creator: Segwang Kim, Hyoungwook Nam, Joonyoung Kim, Kyomin Jung
arxiv-2101-04921.description: Abstract Logical reasoning tasks over symbols, such as learning arithmetic operations and computer program evaluations, have become challenges to deep learning. In particular, even state-of-the-art neural networks fail to achieve out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization of symbolic reasoning tasks, whereas humans can easily extend learned symbolic rules.

arxiv-2103-15693.title: Discrete Yamabe problem for polyhedral surfaces Journal: Discrete & Computational Geometry Thanks: This research was supported by DFG SFB/Transregio 109 “Discretization in Geometry and Dynamics” and the Wittgenstein Prize, Austrian Science Fund (FWF), grant no. Z 342-N31.
arxiv-2103-15693.creator: Hana Dal Poz Kouřimská
arxiv-2103-15693.description: Abstract We study a new discretization of the Gaussian curvature for polyhedral surfaces. This discrete Gaussian curvature is defined on each conical singularity of a polyhedral surface as the quotient of the angle defect and the area of the Voronoi cell corresponding to the singularity.

arxiv-2104-10859.title: Dynamic Spin Fluctuations in the Frustrated Spin Chain Compound Li 3 Cu 2 SbO 6
arxiv-2104-10859.creator: A. Bhattacharyya, T. K. Bhowmik, D. T. Adroja, B. Rahaman, S. Kar, S. Das, T. Saha-Dasgupta, P. K. Biswas, T. P. Sinha, R. A. Ewings, D. D. Khalyavin, A. M. Strydom
arxiv-2104-10859.description: Abstract We report the signatures of dynamic spin fluctuations in the layered honeycomb Li 3 Cu 2 SbO 6 compound, with a 3 d d S = 1/2 d 9 d^{9} Cu 2+ configuration, through muon spin rotation and relaxation ( μ \mu SR) and neutron scattering studies.

arxiv-2205-14963.title: Deuteration of c-C 3 H 2 towards the pre-stellar core L1544
arxiv-2205-14963.creator: K. Giers, S. Spezzano, F. Alves, P. Caselli, E. Redaelli, O. Sipilä, M. Ben Khalifa, L. Wiesenfeld, S. Brünken, L. Bizzocchi
arxiv-2205-14963.description: Abstract Context. In the centre of pre-stellar cores, the deuterium fractionation is enhanced due to the cold temperatures and high densities. Therefore, the chemistry of deuterated molecules can be used to probe the evolution and the kinematics in the earliest stages of star formation. Aims.

arxiv-2304-07062.title: Publicly Verifiable Deletion from Minimal Assumptions
arxiv-2304-07062.creator: Fuyuki Kitagawa, Ryo Nishimaki, Takashi Yamakawa
arxiv-2304-07062.description: Abstract We present a general compiler to add the publicly verifiable deletion property for various cryptographic primitives including public key encryption, attribute-based encryption, and quantum fully homomorphic encryption. Our compiler only uses one-way functions, or more generally hard quantum planted problems for 𝖭𝖯 \mathsf{NP} , which are implied by one-way functions.

arxiv-2405-06373.title: LLM Discussion: Enhancing the Creativity of Large Language Models via Discussion Framework and Role-Play
arxiv-2405-06373.creator: Li-Chun Lu, Shou-Jen Chen, Tsung-Min Pai, Chan-Hung Yu, Hung-yi Lee, Shao-Hua Sun
arxiv-2405-06373.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) have shown exceptional proficiency in natural language processing but often fall short of generating creative and original responses to open-ended questions. To enhance LLM creativity, our key insight is to emulate the human process of inducing collective creativity through engaging discussions with participants from diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

arxiv-2409-04722.title: First joint X-ray solar microflare observations with NuSTAR and Solar Orbiter/STIX
arxiv-2409-04722.creator: Natália Bajnoková, Iain G. Hannah, Kristopher Cooper, Säm Krucker, Brian W. Grefenstette, David M. Smith, Natasha L. S. Jeffrey, Jessie Duncan
arxiv-2409-04722.description: Abstract We present the first joint spectral and imaging analysis of hard X-ray (HXR) emission from 3 microflares observed by the Nuclear Spectroscopic Telescope ARray (NuSTAR) and Solar Orbiter/Spectrometer/Telescope for Imaging X-rays (STIX). We studied 5 joint spectra from GOES A7, B1 and B6 class microflares from active region AR12765 on 2020 June 6 and 7.

arxiv-2507-05429.title: Reducing Disorder-Induced Backscattering in Photonic Crystal Waveguides through Inverse Design
arxiv-2507-05429.creator: Dominic Thompson, Antonia Neill, Nir Rotenberg, Stephen Hughes
arxiv-2507-05429.description: Abstract Photonic crystal waveguides (PCWs) allow for the engineering of photonic modes and band structures to control the flow of light and light-matter interactions within the waveguide. They have shown potential for enhancing optical nonlinearities, quantum dot single photon emissions, as well as optical buffers due to their ability to confine fields on-chip and produce slow-light modes.

britannica-1911-lovelace-richard.title: Lovelace, Richard (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-lovelace-richard.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-lovelace-richard.description: Article 'Lovelace, Richard' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 17), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. He was a scion of a Kentish family, and inherited a tradition of military distinction, maintained by successive generations from the time of Edward III. His father, Sir William Lovelace, had served in the Low Countries, received the honour of knighthood from James I., and was killed at Grolle in 1628.

pmc-10518938.title: Elucidating disease-associated mechanisms triggered by pollutants via the epigenetic landscape using large-scale ChIP-Seq data
pmc-10518938.creator: Zhaonan Zou, Yuka Yoshimura, Yoshihiro Yamanishi, Shinya Oki
pmc-10518938.description: BackgroundDespite well-documented effects on human health, the action modes of environmental pollutants are incompletely understood. Although transcriptome-based approaches are widely used to predict associations between chemicals and disorders, the molecular cues regulating pollutant-derived gene expression changes remain unclear. Therefore, we developed a data-mining approach, termed “DAR-ChIPEA,” to identify transcription factors (TFs) playing pivotal roles in the action modes of pollutants.

pmc-11434314.title: When the Going Gets Tough: A Review of Total Hip Arthroplasty in Patients with Ipsilateral Above- and Below-Knee Amputation
pmc-11434314.creator: Alberto Di Martino, Enrico Capozzi, Matteo Brunello, Claudio D′Agostino, Laura Ramponi, Alessandro Panciera, Federico Ruta, Cesare Faldini
pmc-11434314.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Life expectancy and overall function of amputated patients have improved significantly over the last few decades; for this reason, amputees are more exposed to primary or secondary degenerative disease of the hip, requiring total hip arthroplasty (THA) surgery. However, during training, not all the surgeons acquire adequate skills to manage these patients, and only a few studies and case reports describe technical pearls and outcomes of THA in patients with ipsilateral lower limb amputation, either above or below the knee.

pmc-11588574.title: Small-Molecule Probe for Imaging Oxidative Stress–Induced Carbonylation in Live Cells
pmc-11588574.creator: Ozlem Dilek, Dilek Telci, Hazel Erkan-Candag
pmc-11588574.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Protein carbonylation has been known as the major form of irreversible protein modifications and is also widely used as an indicator of oxidative stress in the biological environment. In the presence of oxidative stress, biological systems tend to produce large amounts of carbonyl moieties; these carbonyl groups do not have particular UV-Vis and fluorescence spectroscopic characteristics that we can differentiate, observe, and detect. Thus, their detection and quantification can only be performed using specific chemical probes.

pmc-11693188.title: FAMILIAL VISITATION OF LONG TERM CARE FACILITY RESIDENTS: DIFFERENTIATING SOCIAL BEHAVIORS FROM CARE COORDINATION
pmc-11693188.creator: Caroline Collins-Pisano, Rachel Weiskittle
pmc-11693188.description: High rates of loneliness persist among residents of long-term care (LTC) facilities despite frequent familial visitation. Most studies on LTC visitation do not differentiate social behavior (e.g., talking to the resident about their interests) from care coordination (e.g., attending the resident’s care conferences). It is possible but unknown if these distinct forms of visitation impact resident loneliness differently.

pmc-12744038.title: Middle Facet Uncoverage Changes after Flexible PCFD Reconstruction
pmc-12744038.creator: Ricardo Villar, Amanda Zeng, Rachel Thompson, Agnes Jones, Jonathan Deland, Scott Ellis, Matthew Conti
pmc-12744038.description: Research Type:Level 3 - Retrospective cohort study, Case-control study, Meta-analysis of Level 3 studiesIntroduction/Purpose:Recently, research has demonstrated an association between the subtalar middle facet uncoverage percentage (MFUP) and Progressive Collapsing Foot Deformity (PCFD). Additionally, a threshold of 17.9% has been suggested to provide 100% specificity and 96.7% sensitivity for the symptomatic, flexible flatfoot.

pmc-12783093.title: FireCastNet: earth-as-a-graph for seasonal fire prediction
pmc-12783093.creator: Dimitrios Michail, Charalampos Davalas, Konstantinos Chafis, Lefki-Ioanna Panagiotou, Ioannis Prapas, Nikolaos Ioannis Bountos, Spyros Kondylatos, Ioannis Papoutsis
pmc-12783093.description: With climate change intensifying fire weather conditions globally, accurate seasonal wildfire forecasting has become critical for disaster preparedness and ecosystem management. We introduce FireCastNet, a novel deep learning architecture that combines 3D convolutional encoding with GraphCast-based Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to model complex spatio-temporal dependencies for global wildfire prediction.

pmc-13059335.title: Targeting metabolic reprogramming to enhance adoptive immunotherapy: emerging mechanisms and translational perspectives
pmc-13059335.creator: Liu Yang, Chengyu Zhang, Zhongxiang Zhang, Songlin Yao, Jing Shen, Zhuo Zhang, Zhangang Xiao, Shurong Wang, Zhigui Wu
pmc-13059335.description: BackgroundAdoptive cell therapy (ACT) has achieved breakthrough advances in the treatment of malignancies, demonstrating particularly remarkable efficacy in hematologic cancers. However, the therapeutic efficacy of ACT remains limited by multiple factors, including low tumor antigen expression, the limited in vivo persistence of infused immune cells, and the immunosuppressive characteristics of the tumor microenvironment (TME).

pmc-13115941.title: Dissection of the Genetic Basis of Maize Plant Architecture and Candidate Gene Mining Based on the MAGIC Population
pmc-13115941.creator: Xiaoming Xu, Kang Zhao, Yukang Zeng, Shaohang Lin, Nadeem Muhammad, Wenhui Gao, Jiaojiao Ren, Penghao Wu
pmc-13115941.description: Background/Objectives: Plant architecture is a critical determinant of high-density tolerance and yield potential in maize (Zea mays L.), yet the genetic networks orchestrating these complex traits require deeper elucidation. Methods: In this study, we utilized a Multi-parent Advanced Generation Inter-cross (MAGIC) population comprising 935 recombinant inbred lines (RILs) derived from 16 diverse elite founders.
